channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: Trump announces building of biggest steel plant in US history
item.description: The steel plant which Mesabi Metallics plans to begin building by 2030 in Iowa, USA, according to the US president, is pricetagged at about €13.2 billion.

item.title: UAE confirms weekend visit by Israeli Prime Minister
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu travelled over the weekend to the UAE, where he met on Sunday with President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan - WAM news agency.

item.title: Putin orders new expansion of Russia's military
item.description: A new mobilisation ordered by Vladimir Putin, the fourth for this year, will increase Russia's armed forces to about 2.4 million people.

item.title: Belgium's National Security Council to discuss hybrid threats on Friday
item.description: The security services and the relevant ministries are working on a plan and measures to counter the growing threats on the European continent.

item.title: US Ambassador Bill White to meet Foreign Minister Prévot over leaked document
item.description: A leaked internal document from Belgium's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that Belgium should no longer consider the United States, led by President Donald Trump, as a reliable ally.

item.title: EU pushes for early recovery in Gaza amid Israeli access constraints
item.description: “Now we need to turn these commitments into results on the ground. Access for staff, equipment and supplies are essential.”

item.title: Belgian man dies while snorkelling in Sardinia
item.description: A 52-year-old Belgian tourist died after falling ill while snorkelling off northern Sardinia. Swimmers spotted him face down in the water and brought him back to shore, but resuscitation efforts failed.

item.title: Boeing experiences software issues with 737 Max planes
item.description: The issue was flagged after a software update and had been due for a permanent fix in 2028, but it now threatens delays for new aircraft variants.

item.title: Road works halt traffic towards the Netherlands
item.description: Traffic towards the Netherlands has been moved overnight onto a temporary three-lane route, with a 70km/h limit and further night-time restrictions still to come.

item.title: OpenAI admits to posting ChatGPT users' photos online
item.description: The company behind ChatGPT accidentally published users' personal information online on 53 separate occasions.

item.title: Thousands of French youths give Leo XIV a rousing welcome
item.description: 'Make some noise for the Pope!' was the rallying cry as 80,000 persons welcomed Leon XIV at a vigil reflecting renewed religious enthusiasm among Catholics in France.

item.title: Google prepares to test its AI chips in space
item.description: Google will send some of its TPU chips into orbit aboard a SpaceX rocket next week to test how they perform in space.

item.title: Iran behind attacks of Jewish sites in Liège and Antwerp, says Belgian intelligence agency
item.description: Perpetrators "certainly" acted on Tehran's orders to strike Jewish and Israeli locations worldwide, according to the Belgian security services.

item.title: Water levels on the Rhine reach a new record low
item.description: Water levels on the Rhine have fallen to exceptionally low levels again, breaking last month’s record low.

item.title: Volkswagen recalls more than 2.8 million vehicles worldwide
item.description: Volkswagen is recalling more than 2.8 million vehicles worldwide because corrosion in a steering system fastening component could affect how the steering works.

item.title: CIA warns Southern Europe of Russian attack with drones hidden inside civilian ships
item.description: By launching from international waters, the drones would be capable of reaching domestic infrastructure within one to two hours.

item.title: Swedish and Finnish fighter jets scrambled to intercept Russian aircraft
item.description: Finnish and Swedish fighter jets were deployed together on Thursday for the first time to intercept Russian military aircraft over the Gulf of Finland.

item.title: Trump's US no longer a 'reliable ally' for Belgium, leaked document suggests
item.description: The leaked internal document from Belgium's Foreign Ministry states that it is now "clear" that the US is no longer "the ally it has been in the past".

item.title: EU reaffirms support for Armenia in face of Russian pressure
item.description: The support measures will liberalise about 80% of Armenian exports to the EU by suspending customs duties.

item.title: Mona Mina Leon becomes first Belgian actress nominated for International Emmy
item.description: Mona Mina Leon has been nominated for the International Emmy Awards for her role in the Streamz series 'Holy Sh!t'.
